description: This file defines a generic internal class MemoryBatchContainer<TSerializer> that implements IBatchContainer and IOnDeserialized interfaces, managing memory-based message batching for stream processing, including serialization, deserialization, and event retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: MemoryBatchContainer`1
classes.description: A container for batching memory messages in stream processing, with serialization support.

methods.name: Payload
methods.description: Lazy loads and caches the deserialized message payload.

methods.name: MemoryBatchContainer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the batch container with message data and serializer.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves the events stored in the message data, cast to the specified type, each associated with the current sequence token.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Imports the request context from the message payload into the current context.
